11-2D-5. - Standards in the traditional neighborhood center district (TN-C).
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT11UNDECO_CH2DIRE_ARTDTRNEDI_11-2D-5STTRNECEDI","Title":"11-2D-5. - Standards in the traditional neighborhood center district (TN-C).","Content":"
\n

\n The standards for development in the traditional neighborhood center district are\n set forth in this section as follows:\n \n

\n A.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Maximum building height is forty-five (45) feet.\n

\n \t\t\n \n

\n B.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Minimum number of stories for new construction adjacent to any street is two (2).\n

\n \t\t\n \n

\n C.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Maximum building footprint is twenty thousand (20,000) square feet; however, other\n than retail, all other uses may be allowed a footprint of greater than twenty thousand\n (20,000) square feet through the conditional use permit process.\n

\n \t\t\n \n

\n D.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Minimum contiguous district size is six (6) acres; or two (2) acres when adjacent\n to property with a mixed-use future land use designation.\n

\n \t\t\n \n

\n (Ord. 05-1170, 8-30-2005, eff. 9-15-2005; Ord. 08-1372, 7-8-2008, eff. 7-8-2008; Ord.\n 16-1717, 1-3-2017)\n
